query: LTX-2.5 GGUF models have 3 BF16 non-layer params (learnable_registers, keyframes_abs_pos_embedding) left as GGMLTensor, so packed BF16 storage dims (e.g. 4096 vs 8192) leak into runtime ops and crash samplers.

desired.outcome: OP-verified fix: after gguf_sd_loader(), materialize only those three named BF16 tensors via dequantize_tensor() before load_diffusion_model_state_dict(); full workflow then runs (OP offers a PR for this in loader.py).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
desired.answer_guidance: OP-verified fix: after gguf_sd_loader(), materialize only those three named BF16 tensors via dequantize_tensor() before load_diffusion_model_state_dict(); full workflow then runs (OP offers a PR for this in loader.py).
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Debug inside third-party GGUF loader code: recognize that packed-BF16 storage dims leak for named non-layer tensors and patch tensor materialization before model load, not the workflow.
